question_text: Which areas of the venue had the most crowd activity? Rank them by their average crowd size.
answer_text: The areas with the most crowd activity, ranked by average crowd size, were: 1) KeynoteHall_Stage with an average crowd size of 57.3975, 2) ExpoFloor_MainAisle with 49.3567, 3) FoodCourt_North with 23.0696, 4) DemoBooth_NVIDIA with 15.5150, and 5) DemoBooth_Intel with 10.6483.

citations.cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)
  WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  RETURN ch.camera_location AS location, avg(ch.avg_hc) AS avg_crowd_size
}
RETURN location, avg_crowd_size
ORDER BY avg_crowd_size DESC
